card.name: Linking words after metal ion mentions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (commas, an, of, form, by, which) right after a metal cation or ion has been named, where the next word is likely about ions or binding.

modes.label: Cation then verb or link
modes.description: Comma, article or verb right after a divalent or multivalent cation, before it coordinates or chelates.

modes.description: Linking word before ionized or ion-pair terms in chemistry or electrolyte text.

card.writes: It nudges the next word toward ion and concentration terms and away from modification and oxidation words.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words right after a metal ion is mentioned, as the text moves on to what the ion binds or does.
